statement: Complete classification of local sections in the actual single-cusp marked-depth quotient whose inertia dies after filling the marked cusp; exact central Frobenius parameter and an explicit single-ray ramified class without a full lift.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d); single marked cusp Q=B0 of E41.1
notes: The exact source is W=Pi/gamma3(I_Q), with I_Q the closed normal closure of the actual positive peripheral generator at B0.
The normal form covers the locus with trivial image of inertia in B=Pi/I_Q. Its ramified classes are (a,b,w), a nonzero in Z3, b modulo q-1, and w in C/(q^2 wedge2(theta)-1)C.
The zero-D inertia case forces trivial inertia. Every resulting unramified class has a full lift; the full unramified normal form is reserved for E68.
C is the explicit compact inverse exterior module on the actual profinite coset space B. No closure is added to its already compact coboundary image.

At q4 the first-moment quotient is (Z/9)^5 times (Z/27)^2. The literal word [d_B0,d_A0 d_B0 d_A0^-1] is detected by the displayed mod3 character, and gives a ramified marked-depth section with one cusp inertia ray and no full lift.
The theorem does not classify marked-depth sections whose inertia has nontrivial image in B. It uses no unverified theta coefficient.

Root and D independently read the full proof and freshly ran copied code. Both complete JSON certificates are identical to the retained source certificate. The alternating-measure integral includes the required factor1/2; displayed bilinear maps and the finite witness already use this normalization. Full audits PASS.
